description: This file contains utility functions for calculating burndown charts in a project management context, specifically for scrum sprints. It includes functions to compute remaining story points over time, handle date enumeration, and process issues with respect to resolution dates for burndown analysis.

methods.name: computeBurndown({ startDateISO, endDateISO, issues = [], storyPointsFieldId = 'customfield_10016' })
methods.description: Calculates the remaining story points and ideal burndown line for a sprint based on issue data and sprint dates.

methods.name: enumerateDays(startISO, endISO)
methods.description: Generates a list of ISO-formatted date strings for each day within a given start and end date range.

methods.name: toDayISO(d)
methods.description: Converts a Date object or date string to a standardized ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: isDayInRange(dayISO, startDayISO, endDayISO)
methods.description: Checks if a given day (ISO string) falls within a specified start and end day range.

methods.name: round2(n)
methods.description: Rounds a number to two decimal places.
